question_text: Read the paragraph below and identify the sentence that DISRUPTS its logical flow. explanation: B is correct — Sentence 2 (recycling rates and policy failure) shifts the passage from the health impact of microplastics to waste management statistics, disrupting the medical evidence chain (detection in the body → toxic effects → call for health research); recycling policy is a separate issue not addressed elsewhere in the paragraph. C is wrong — Sentence 3 (toxic chemicals and hormonal disruption) deepens the health mechanism, logically following Sentence 1. D is wrong — Sentence 4 (call for health research) is a logical conclusion following from Sentences 1 and 3.
